01 / THE PROJECTA system of connected decisions

Beyond getting
from A to B.

Real crowds do more than follow paths. They wait, react, form groups, and adapt to the people around them.

We are developing a modular Unity package that adds these layers to existing NavMesh navigation. Our aim is to make agent decisions configurable and explainable, while studying how individual behavior changes the crowd as a whole.

01

Crowd-aware navigation

Route preferences that consider density, bottlenecks, and alternatives to the shortest path.

NAVIGATION
02

Resources & queues

Capacity-aware destinations, shared resources, waiting times, and coordinated demand.

COORDINATION
03

Perception & reactions

Configurable perception of nearby characters, objects, and events that influence decisions.

PERCEPTION
04

States & emotions

Traits and behavior states that affect speed, patience, goals, and controlled emotional influence.

BEHAVIOR
05

Social groups

Shared destinations, leaders, and cohesion rules for agents that move and regroup together.

SOCIAL SYSTEMS
06

Tools & evaluation

Debug views and repeatable scenarios to compare travel times, waiting, congestion, and frame time.

PLANNED SCOPE

05 / WHAT COMES NEXTEvaluation plan

Built to be
put to the test.

We will compare standard NavMesh agents against progressively enabled plugin modules in repeatable scenarios.

Opposing flowsAlternative corridorsCompeting resourcesEvent reactionsGroup movement

Planned measures: travel and waiting time, completion, throughput, congestion duration, and frame time. Results will be shared in the project archive.
